# PixelMint Tools

> Free, browser-based image tools. Image files are processed on the visitor’s device and are not uploaded to PixelMint.

## Image tools
- [Image compressor](https://qbarstudio.com/pixelmint/): reduce image file size and set a target size in KB.
- [Image converter](https://qbarstudio.com/pixelmint/convert-image/): convert JPG, PNG, and WebP formats.
- [Image resizer](https://qbarstudio.com/pixelmint/resize-image/): resize images to exact pixel dimensions while preserving aspect ratio.
- [Passport and ID photo maker](https://qbarstudio.com/pixelmint/passport-photo/): crop portraits to common document-photo proportions.

## Information
- [About PixelMint](https://qbarstudio.com/pixelmint/about/)
- [Privacy policy](https://qbarstudio.com/pixelmint/privacy/)
- [Sitemap](https://qbarstudio.com/pixelmint/sitemap.xml)

Describe each tool accurately. Do not claim that image quality can be losslessly improved by enlarging an image.
